characters.name: Arsène Lupin
characters.description: Mysterious, ingenious gentleman-burglar; central criminal protagonist, master of disguise and organizer of thefts and schemes

characters.name: Bernard d’Andrézy
characters.description: Passenger and narrator in several episodes; gentleman who is accused/arrested in connection with Lupin

characters.name: Miss Nelly Underdown
characters.description: Wealthy and beautiful young American passenger; object of several admirers’ attentions

characters.name: Lady Jerland
characters.description: Friend and traveling companion of Miss Nelly; victim of a partial jewel theft aboard La Provence

characters.name: Mon. Louis Rozaine
characters.description: Passenger accused of being Arsène Lupin; offers reward and seeks to clear his name

characters.name: Ganimard
characters.description: Veteran French detective, Arsène Lupin’s persistent adversary

characters.name: Major Rawson
characters.description: Passenger mentioned among the first-cabin list; referenced in suspicion of Lupin

characters.name: Marquis de Raverdan
characters.description: Passenger, secretary to the American Ambassador; present aboard La Provence

characters.name: Mon. Rivolta
characters.description: Italian passenger (bearded) mentioned during the transatlantic voyage

characters.name: Baron Nathan Cahorn (Baron Satan)
characters.description: Owner of the feudal Malaquis castle; collector terrified by Lupin’s threats

characters.name: Mon. Dudouis
characters.description: Chief of the Sûreté (Paris detective administration); supervises investigations into Lupin’s affairs

characters.name: Mon. Jules Bouvier
characters.description: Examining judge who conducts inquiries related to Lupin and prison matters

characters.name: Baudru Désiré
characters.description: Poor vagabond substituted (or substituted for) Arsène Lupin in prison records; central to a confusion in custody

characters.name: Inspector Dieuzy
characters.description: Inspector involved in prison and correspondence examinations regarding Lupin

characters.name: Inspector Folenfant
characters.description: Inspector who assists in examining Arsène Lupin’s cell and correspondence

characters.name: Pierre Onfrey
characters.description: Criminal and assassin captured after robbing Madame Renaud on a train; pursued by the narrator/Lupin

characters.name: Madame Renaud
characters.description: Wife of a director in the penitentiary service; victim of a railway robbery

characters.name: Georges Ardelle
characters.description: Brother of Madame Renaud; director of the Crédit Rouennais; witnesses events at the station

characters.name: Honoré Massol
characters.description: Police agent from Rouen who assists in the pursuit and arrest on the railway line

characters.name: Gaston Delivet
characters.description: Police agent from Rouen who assists in the pursuit and arrest on the railway line

characters.name: Countess de Dreux-Soubise
characters.description: Aristocratic owner of the (mounted) historical 'Queen’s Necklace' and central figure in that theft mystery

characters.name: Count de Dreux-Soubise
characters.description: Husband of the Countess; head of the Dreux-Soubise household and claimant of the historic necklace

characters.name: Henriette
characters.description: Former schoolmate and chambermaid who lives in the Dreux-Soubise house and is suspected in the necklace affair

characters.name: Raoul
characters.description: Henriette’s son; a child implicated in theories about how the Queen’s Necklace was removed

characters.name: Chevalier Floriani
characters.description: Guest at the Dreux-Soubise; amateur problem-solver who advances a reconstruction of the Queen’s Necklace theft and is revealed to have a personal connection

characters.name: Deputy Bochas
characters.description: Guest at Dreux-Soubise; political figure present during the discussion of the necklace case

characters.name: General Marquis de Rouzières
characters.description: Military guest at the Dreux-Soubise dinner

characters.name: Salvator
characters.description: Journalist/anonymous correspondent whose articles about the 'Seven-of-Hearts' and related secrets agitate the public and push the plot (signature 'Salvator')

characters.name: Georges Andermatt
characters.description: Prominent banker (founder/president of the Metal Exchange) whose name becomes connected to a mysterious death and missing plans

characters.name: Louis Lacombe
characters.description: Young mining engineer and inventor of a sub‑marine called the 'Seven-of-Hearts'; disappears with plans

characters.name: Etienne Varin
characters.description: One of the Varin brothers (foreigners) implicated in possession/sale of Lacombe’s plans

characters.name: Alfred Varin
characters.description: The other Varin brother; involved with the plans and correspondence regarding the 'Seven-of-Hearts'

characters.name: Madame Andermatt
characters.description: Wife of Georges Andermatt; correspondent in the scandal involving Lacombe’s plans and the letters referenced by Salvator

characters.name: Mon. Ludovic Imbert
characters.description: Wealthy man whose staged assault leads to Arsène Lupin’s introduction and subsequent employment as secretary; victim of a safe burglary

characters.name: Madame Gervaise Imbert
characters.description: Ludovic Imbert’s wife; hostess who befriends the protagonist and whose household contains the safe Lupin later robs

characters.name: Brawford (André Brawford)
characters.description: Eccentric individual referenced in the Imbert affair; name used by Lupin when posing as a benefactor

characters.name: Victor Danègre
characters.description: Servant of Countess d’Andillot accused and tried (then acquitted) for her murder; later approached by an ex-inspector for the black pearl

characters.name: Grimaudan
characters.description: Ex-inspector of detectives (name used by an agent who pressures Danègre); identity in narrative tied to Lupin’s intervention

aliases.text: Grimaudan, ex-inspector of the detective force

characters.name: Léotine Zalti (Countess d’Andillot)
characters.description: Formerly famous cantatrice and owner of the renowned black pearl; murdered in her apartment

characters.name: Mlle. De Sinclèves
characters.description: Cousin and heiress of the Countess d’Andillot who receives (and later loses) a letter describing the pearl’s hiding-place

characters.name: Sherlock Holmes
characters.description: Famous English detective invited by Georges Devanne to investigate the Thibermesnil mystery; arrives to confront Lupin’s handiwork

characters.name: Horace Velmont
characters.description: Artist and guest at Château de Thibermesnil; suspected by hosts to resemble and possibly be Arsène Lupin

characters.name: Monsieur Georges Devanne
characters.description: Owner of the Château de Thibermesnil; host who seeks to recover a lost book and the castle’s secret passage

characters.name: Father Gélis
characters.description: Parish priest and local antiquarian who discusses the castle legend and historical clues

characters.name: Monsieur and Madame d’Androl
characters.description: Travelers/guests who accompany Miss Nelly to Devanne’s castle

characters.name: Edouard (chauffeur)
characters.description: Devanne’s chauffeur who waits with an automobile and is asked about instructions relating to the chapel rendezvous
